Few sports attract as much betting interest as the NFL. From the opening week of the regular season through the NFL playoffs and Super Bowl, bettors have hundreds of games and thousands of betting opportunities to follow.

NFL betting extends well beyond wagering on games each week. Season-long futures and award markets provide additional opportunities, while the NFL Draft and other markets keep NFL betting going during the offseason.

Whether you are looking for NFL odds and picks, researching a bet, or following the biggest storylines of the 2026 season, this NFL betting guide can help you stay informed from Week 1 through Super Bowl 61 and beyond.

Explore Our NFL Guides to Hone Your Handicapping Skills

NFL betting involves a lot more than picking winners each week. From researching matchups and evaluating betting lines to choosing how and when to wager, there is a lot for bettors to consider. Our NFL betting guides can help you navigate those different parts of the process.

If you want to strengthen your research, start with our guide on how to handicap an NFL game. You can also learn which NFL stats and metrics are worth understanding, how to read NFL injury reports, and what to consider when evaluating the NFL schedule.

Our guides also dig deeper into specific NFL betting markets. Learn more about NFL spread betting, explore the wider range of NFL prop bets, or find out how NFL teasers work. You can also follow season-long markets with our NFL MVP betting guide.

Those are only some of the NFL betting topics we cover. Visit our NFL Betting Guides hub to explore the full collection, including guides dedicated to handicapping, betting research, odds and lines, major NFL events, and more.

Best NFL Betting Sites: Where to Bet on the NFL

Many top online sportsbooks offer NFL odds throughout the year. Bettors can wager on weekly games during the regular season and playoffs, along with futures and awards such as NFL MVP.

With so many options available, choosing the right sportsbook can come down to the odds, markets, features, and overall betting experience it provides. Our best NFL betting sites page takes a closer look at top options such as Lucky Rebel, BetOnline, and Everygame.

Comparing sportsbooks can also help you determine which features matter most to you and whether available sportsbook bonuses and promotions are worth claiming.

NFL Betting Resources

Having reliable betting tools and resources at your disposal can make researching NFL bets much easier. Betting News provides NFL picks, odds, analysis, and other resources throughout the season, while numerous other websites and tools can help you research games and betting markets.

NFL Betting Picks

Seeing how trusted sources bet or lean can provide another perspective when evaluating a matchup.

Our NFL picks page features consensus moneyline, point spread, and over/under picks from numerous sports betting industry sources for every game. Those picks are paired with current sportsbook odds from Lucky Rebel, BetOnline, and other top NFL betting sites, giving you an easy way to compare opinions and see how different sources are approaching each matchup.

Varun Sharma and our other NFL analysts also provide expert picks and analysis throughout the season. Our weekly coverage includes expert picks for each NFL matchup, picks for touchdown scorer props and other prop bets, and NFL staff picks from members of the Betting News team.

You can find even more picks and discussion through the Betting News Network. Shows such as Afternoon Betspresso, The Morning Spread, and Any Given Wager give bettors additional insight throughout the week.

Betting News isn’t the only place to find weekly NFL picks. TipMaster.ai and Doc’s Sports are among the other free or premium options available to bettors. You can also explore our recommendations for the best follows on gambling Twitter and places to buy premium sports picks.

NFL Betting Odds

NFL odds can differ from one sportsbook to another, so comparing prices can be worthwhile before placing a bet.

Our NFL odds page brings moneyline, point spread, and total odds together for each game. That helps streamline line shopping by allowing you to compare sportsbooks in one place. With your extra time, you can become a grill master or the best cornhole player in the tri-state area.

Other NFL Betting Resources

Picks and odds are only part of the information NFL bettors can use. Statistics, injury information, news, schedules, and other research tools can all provide useful context when evaluating games and betting markets.

There are numerous websites and tools available for those purposes. Our NFL betting resources guide brings many of them together, including resources for statistics, injuries, news, weather, schedules, and other information you may want during your NFL betting research.

Keep Up with the 2026 NFL Season

Every NFL season is a journey from Week 1 to the Super Bowl, with plenty changing along the way. Division races develop, contenders emerge or fall back, and the postseason picture becomes clearer as 32 teams compete for 14 playoff spots.

Throughout the 2026 season, we will keep this section updated with the latest NFL standings and an evolving look at the road to Super Bowl 61.

As the postseason approaches, visit our NFL Playoffs hub for playoff odds, betting information, and postseason content, while our Super Bowl hub will help you prepare for the biggest betting event of the NFL season.

The Road to Super Bowl 61

The journey to Super Bowl 61 begins with all 32 teams chasing the same destination: SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California. Before the AFC and NFC champions get there, the regular season will determine eight division winners and six wild-card teams that advance to the NFL playoffs.

We will update this space throughout the season as that picture develops. From emerging contenders and changing division races to late-season playoff scenarios, postseason matchups, and eventually the conference championship games, follow along as the road to Super Bowl 61 takes shape.

2026 NFL Season Calendar: Games & Events to Know

There is rarely a quiet week during an NFL season. The bulk of the schedule takes place on Sunday afternoons, but Thursday Night Football, Sunday Night Football, and Monday Night Football provide a steady stream of standalone matchups throughout the year. As the season progresses, flex scheduling and late-season Saturday games add even more variety to the weekly slate.

Some of the most distinctive games of 2026 will take place far from the usual NFL cities. A record nine international games will be played across seven countries, including the league’s first regular-season game in Australia. The international schedule will also take the NFL to Brazil, England, France, Germany, Mexico, and Spain.

The schedule changes again around the holidays. Thanksgiving week brings NFL games on Wednesday, Thanksgiving Day, and Black Friday, while Christmas Day features three more games. By then, the regular season will be entering its final stretch and many of those standalone matchups could carry significant weight in division and playoff races.

Where and when a game is played can also matter when evaluating a matchup. Short weeks, extended rest, bye weeks, long-distance travel, and other scheduling situations are among the factors bettors can consider when analyzing the NFL schedule throughout the season.
